data.name: Fujiwara Mokou (Touhou)
data.teaser: Immortal Being in SPT, now you can RP not dying to anything.
data.description:
Hey, it’s been a while. I’m releasing another mod. This one adds Fujiwara No Mokou from the Touhou series as a playable character for SPT. It should also work on FIKA.

Some backstory: The character drank a potion granting immortality to the person. and it’s complete immortality. Picture the Undertaker if he actually could not be killed and had fire powers and was an anime chick lol

so if you want to use Dad Gamer Mode or give yourself a ridiculous amount of health, go for it. Install Instructions: You can follow my Reisen mod instructions and the mod will work much the same as that one does. Or you can use the SkinService mod to switch to her model. I will link the latter here: Skin Service

I will have to add code for her clothing or model to appear in Ragman’s services or in WTT’s head/voice/clothing changer.

I will include pics here for reference. Please let me know of any issues that pop up with the character. NOTE: There is clipping and an issue with gas masks on the character. Helmets are fine but will clip through hair. if this doesn’t bother you, then you’ll have fun using the mod.

This mod has been updated to 3.11 version for SPT users. The install instructions are labeled in the version but to sum up are the exact same as the Reisen mod. Please read thoroughly to avoid any mistakes in installation.

Credit to Modder Magyeong for their help with this and GroovyPenguin for the framework, the mod wouldn’t be possible without either.

versions.description:
I finally updated this mod to SPT version 3.11. How to install: go tp Profiles go the one you use or are active on, scroll down until you see body/head lines etc and swap the original ID's from whatever character you have to the ones in this mod's DB folder. they are for Mokou and work in game and in the menus. This is a similar solution as the Reisen mod. hopefully once the Skin Service mod updates, I can redirect people to that mod for using this one more readily.

Until then, Enjoy!
